tools.name: formspark_whoami
tools.description: Describe the API token in use: its name, scopes, expiry and last use. Good first call to see what this connection can read. Formspark API: GET /me.

tools.name: formspark_list_workspaces
tools.description: List the workspaces this token can reach, with plan (FREE or an upgraded plan), submission quota and timestamps. Use the ids in the other tools. Formspark API: GET /workspaces.

tools.name: formspark_list_forms
tools.description: List the forms in one workspace, with name, notification emails, threading and spam settings. Formspark API: GET /forms.

tools.name: formspark_get_form
tools.description: Get one form by id, including its settings and notification emails. Captcha secrets are never returned. Formspark API: GET /forms/{formId}.

tools.name: formspark_list_form_submissions
tools.description: List the newest submissions of one form, with their field values and timestamps. Pass nextCursor back as startingAfter for the next page. Formspark API: GET /forms/{formId}/submissions.

tools.name: formspark_list_workspace_submissions
tools.description: List the newest submissions across every form in one workspace. Pass nextCursor back as startingAfter for the next page. Formspark API: GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/submissions.

tools.name: formspark_create_form
tools.description: Create a form in a workspace with a name, an optional description and notification emails. Needs an upgraded workspace and the forms:write scope. Formspark API: POST /forms.

tools.name: formspark_update_form
tools.description: Change a form's name, description, notification emails or threading. Sends only the fields you pass; null clears a text field. Formspark API: PATCH /forms/{formId}.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "formspark_get_form" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Get one form by id, including its settings and notification emails. Captcha secrets are never returned. Formspark API: GET /forms/{formId}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: formspark_list_forms, formspark_get_form · Private data: formspark_whoami, formspark_list_workspaces, formspark_get_form · Public sink: formspark_create_form.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: formspark_list_forms, formspark_get_form · Private data: formspark_whoami, formspark_list_workspaces, formspark_get_form · Public sink: formspark_create_form

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
